verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change correctly binds unredacted ops-alert bodies to the existing live private-repository probe: `_alert_route` is the sole positive producer, normalized destination membership carries that verdict to `_ops_alert`, and every unverified, refused, same-repository, half-configured, or direct-call path defaults to public-body redaction. Redaction occurs before the shared create/comment branch and remains inside the best-effort exception boundary. The added self-tests are non-vacuous and cover confirmed-private delivery, case normalization, refused-route fallback with preservation of the salted hash, direct unverified invocation, and redaction failure containment. The workflow commentary matches the implemented contract. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
